cases.name: CHK-001: failed case does not save trace
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-failsave.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-failsave.json","fc",[{fn:"original",file:"o.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-failsave.json","fc"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return snap.trace[0].fn==="original"

cases.name: CHK-001: tampered trace json no crash
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-tamper.json","tc",[{fn:"ok",file:"o.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-tamper.trace.json"); fs.writeFileSync(traceFile,"not json at all"); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-tamper.json","tc"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return snap === null

cases.name: CHK-007: private method not in blindZones
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const testFile = path.join($root, "packages", "main", "src", "__test_priv.ts"); fs.writeFileSync(testFile, ["export class Priv { _internal() { return 1; } public pub() { return 2; } }",""].join(String.fromCharCode(10))); try { const result = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); const parsed = JSON.parse(result); const zones = parsed.blindZones || []; const hasInternal = zones.some(z => z.includes("_internal")); const hasPub = zones.some(z => z.includes("Priv.pub")); return !hasInternal && hasPub; } finally { try { fs.rmSync(testFile); } catch {} }

cases.name: CHK-001: chain case load uses pre-save snapshot
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-chain.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-chain.json","chain",[{fn:"v0",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap1 = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-chain.json","chain"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-chain.json","chain",[{fn:"v1",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap2 = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-chain.json","chain"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return snap1.trace[0].fn==="v0" && snap2.trace[0].fn==="v1"

cases.name: CHK-004: session error recovery
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const s = new m.FixtureProfilerSession(); await s.open(); await s.startCase(); await s.stopCase(); await s.close(); const s2 = new m.FixtureProfilerSession(); await s2.open(); await s2.startCase(); const t = await s2.stopCase(); await s2.close(); return Array.isArray(t)

cases.name: CHK-005: blindZones no anonymous entries
cases.execute: const result = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); const parsed = JSON.parse(result); if(!parsed.blindZones) return true; return !parsed.blindZones.some(z => z.startsWith("(anonymous)@"))

cases.name: CHK-005: impactGraph no anonymous edges
cases.execute: const result = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); const parsed = JSON.parse(result); if(!parsed.impactGraph) return true; return !parsed.impactGraph.some(e => (e.from.startsWith("(anonymous)@") && e.from.endsWith("@")) || (e.to.startsWith("(anonymous)@") && e.to.endsWith("@")))

cases.name: CHK-001: load before save returns previous not current
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-order.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-order.json","oc",[{fn:"prev",file:"p.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const prevSnap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-order.json","oc"); const newTrace = [{fn:"curr",file:"c.ts",line:2,children:[]}]; const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const diff = diffTraces(prevSnap.trace, newTrace); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-order.json","oc",newTrace); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return prevSnap.trace[0].fn==="prev" && diff.added.length>0

cases.name: CHK-004: profiler stop after exception
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const s = new m.FixtureProfilerSession(); await s.open(); await s.startCase(); try { throw new Error('simulated timeout'); } catch { try { await s.stopCase(); } catch {} } await s.close(); const s2 = new m.FixtureProfilerSession(); await s2.open(); await s2.startCase(); const t = await s2.stopCase(); await s2.close(); return Array.isArray(t)

cases.name: CHK-008: restore/clean only affects fixturesDir
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const marker = path.join($root, "__outside_fixtures_" + Date.now() + ".txt"); fs.writeFileSync(marker, "should survive"); const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const result = execSync("git status --porcelain", {cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8"}); const survived = fs.existsSync(marker); fs.rmSync(marker, {force:true}); return survived

cases.name: CHK-008: traces outside fixturesDir survive restore
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const tracesDir = path.join($root, ".koala", "traces"); fs.mkdirSync(tracesDir, {recursive:true}); const marker = path.join(tracesDir, "__survive_test_" + Date.now() + ".json"); fs.writeFileSync(marker, "{}"); const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const result = execSync("git status --porcelain", {cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8"}); const survived = fs.existsSync(marker); fs.rmSync(marker, {force:true}); return survived

cases.name: CHK-008: file outside fixturesDir not deleted
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const marker = path.join($root, "packages", "main", "src", "__temp_test_" + Date.now() + ".txt"); fs.writeFileSync(marker, "temp"); const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const result = execSync("git status --porcelain", {cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8"}); const survived = fs.existsSync(marker); fs.rmSync(marker, {force:true}); return survived

cases.name: CHK-008: fixturesDir cleanup removes untracked files
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join($root, "koala.config.json"), "utf-8")); const junkFile = path.join($root, config.fixturesDir, "__junk_" + Date.now() + ".json"); fs.writeFileSync(junkFile, "{}"); const existed = fs.existsSync(junkFile); const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const result = execSync("git status --porcelain", {cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8"}); const cleaned = !fs.existsSync(junkFile); try{fs.rmSync(junkFile,{force:true});}catch{} return existed && cleaned

cases.name: CHK-008: fixture writing outside fixturesDir survives cleanup
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const marker = path.join($root, "docs", "__outside_fixture_" + Date.now() + ".txt"); fs.writeFileSync(marker, "should survive"); const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const result = execSync("git status --porcelain", {cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8"}); const survived = fs.existsSync(marker); fs.rmSync(marker, {force:true}); return survived

cases.name: CHK-008: git clean on clean fixturesDir no error
cases.execute: const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join($root, "koala.config.json"), "utf-8")); try { execSync('git clean -fd "' + config.fixturesDir + '"', {cwd:$root,stdio:"pipe"}); execSync('git restore "' + config.fixturesDir + '"', {cwd:$root,stdio:"pipe"}); return true; } catch(e) { return "git clean error: " + e.message; }
